ITEM.PTXT: NAVI AI-SHIFT has been adopted, which selects the appropriate gear ratio according to the road shape and road gradient, obtained by combining the road corner information from the navigation computer (built into the multi-display) with the road gradient information calculated by the engine control computer, and the vehicle information from the vehicle side.

Voice messages such as "Thank you for driving. ", "Today is ○ month × day, △ day of the week. " can be given when arriving home or getting into the vehicle. Heartful voice "On"/"Off" is set from "Navigation Detailed Settings" in the Setup/Edit screen.
